item.title: Boys & Girls Club making plans to return to LaGrange this summer
item.description: Boys & Girls Club eyes summer return to LaGrange, seeking county OK to use Tod Tentler Sports Complex classrooms for an after-school program serving 40–60 students.

item.title: Mr. Julian Doyle Sanders

item.title: Gardner Newman beats Long Cane on opening day
item.description: The middle school baseball season got underway in Troup County on Tuesday as the Gardner Newman Mustangs hosted rival Long Cane at George Harris baseball complex. The Mustangs would use a late surge to earn a 10-1 win. Gardner Newman opened the scoring in the bottom of the third inning on an RBI single from Woods Griffin. item.title: Troup boys and girls soccer teams scrimmage Springwood
item.description: TROUP BOYS - 2 SPRINGWOOD - 6 A new era of Troup High boys soccer got underway on Tuesday evening at Callaway Stadium as the team played its first scrimmage under first-year head coach Mike Townson. While the Tigers took a 6-2 loss to the Springwood Wildcats, there was more to the game than the final score. Before the Tigers emptied their bench in the second half, Troup had control of the game.
